reviewMethod: Define one concrete task and the acceptance criteria before choosing a product.
Use representative, fictional or redacted inputs and the same test set for each candidate.
Record product, model/version, configuration, and test date.
Check outputs against trusted sources and record errors, editing effort, and limitations.
Review data handling, terms, platform compatibility, and cost on official pages.
Publish a product review only after a repeatable test; do not infer a general ranking from one task.

useCases.title: Organize supplied SEO evidence
useCases.description: Use a prompt or skill to structure manually collected, authorized page or crawl evidence into questions for a human reviewer. It does not crawl a site.

useCases.title: Prepare a content brief
useCases.description: Turn an approved audience, intent, product facts, and source list into an outline that an editor can review before drafting.

useCases.title: Plan a campaign test
useCases.description: Record an objective, approved claims, audience assumptions, conversion event, and a creative hypothesis before entering an advertising platform.

useCases.title: Summarize a local reporting file
useCases.description: Run a standard-library example locally against a CSV you are authorized to use; the sample script does not upload data.

comparisonGuidance: Choose a concrete task before comparing tools.
Use the same sanitized inputs and success criteria for each test.
Record product, model/version, configuration, and test date.
Check outputs against trusted sources and inspect privacy, terms, and integration requirements.
Do not interpret a small test as a universal ranking.
